content: The checkout process crashes when I try to apply a discount code. This has happened 3 times this week.
Love the new dashboard redesign! Much easier to find what I need now.
Your mobile app is incredibly slow on Android. Takes 8+ seconds to load the home screen.
Can you add a dark mode option? I use the app late at night and the white background is blinding.
The export to PDF feature is broken - it only exports the first page of my report.
Absolutely love the AI suggestions feature. It saved our team hours of manual categorization.
We need SSO integration. Our security team won't approve the tool without it.
The search function doesn't find results when I use Spanish characters like ñ or accents.
Notifications are overwhelming. I get 50+ emails a day from your platform. Need better controls.
The onboarding flow is confusing. I didn't understand what 'sources' meant until day 3.
Pricing is too high for startups. The Growth plan at $109/mo is hard to justify with only 5 users.
API rate limits are too low. We hit the ceiling every day during peak hours.
The sentiment analysis is surprisingly accurate. Caught a negative trend we missed manually.
Please add Intercom integration. We use it for all customer communication.
The weekly synthesis email is the most useful feature. Our PM reads it every Monday morning.
I can't delete old feedbacks. There's no bulk delete option and one-by-one is painful.
The pipeline kanban board needs drag-and-drop. Currently I have to click through menus to move items.
Great product but the mobile responsive design needs work. Sidebar overlaps content on tablets.
Would love Zapier integration so we can connect with our CRM automatically.
The CSV import failed silently on a 5000-row file. No error message, just nothing happened.
Checkout page shows wrong currency for EU users. We see USD instead of EUR.
The AI chat feature is amazing for quick insights. Replaced our weekly analysis meetings.
Need better role permissions. Members can see billing info which should be owner-only.
Loading times improved dramatically after last update. Dashboard loads in under 2 seconds now.
The Slack integration missed several messages from our feedback channel last week.
Can we get a public roadmap page? Our users keep asking what features are coming next.
Filter by date range is broken. Selecting 'last 30 days' shows data from 60 days ago.
We switched from Productboard to FeedbackMind and the migration was seamless. Great job!
The typeform survey sync takes too long. Responses from yesterday still haven't appeared.
Please add keyboard shortcuts. Power users like me want to navigate without touching the mouse.
